items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 47:1
items.html: The AHP that fell and went out beyond every degree by force of the rise of the bottom Hey to Einayim are called by the name Mantzpach. And the reason they are so called is that this AHP is the aspect of the ending of the degree, namely TNHYM, and it is known that the ten Sefirot of NHY are the aspect of the ending of every degree; therefore they are called by the name Mantzpach, the final letters of the alphabet that end every word. You already know that vessels are called letters, and the letters of the face, which are the aspect of Rosh and Toch of the Partzuf, are the aspect of the twenty-two letters, while the final letters in the Partzuf are the aspect of the final Mantzpach.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 47:2
items.html: These Mantzpach are called the essence of the five Gevurot [HG], which return to the Partzuf only at the time of Gadlut. However, at the time of Katnut, the Partzuf receives only the aspect of the illumination of the Mantzpach, and not the Mantzpach itself. That is to say, at the time when there is only the aspect of Rosh and Guf in the Partzuf, and the bottom Hey is in Einayim, the Partzuf then has only the aspect of VAK, which are called HG, namely HGT NH, as is known. However this is only from the aspect of the level of the lights, which is the level of ZA; but on the side of the vessels it has Keter and Hochma, namely Galgalta and Einayim, only that they are called HGT NH after the lights, which are Nefesh and Ruach. Therefore this is called by the name illumination of HG, meaning HG from the aspect of lights, and not from the aspect of vessels, as above. However, at Gadlut, when the AHP return to it, it then acquires the essence of HG, meaning also the aspect of the vessels of HG. So the HG of the lights are found clothed in the HG of their vessels, and therefore the HG acquire the aspect of GAR. For at the time of Katnut, when it had HG only from the side of the lights and not from the side of the vessels, the HG were clothed not in their own place, but in the upper vessels, and the Partzuf was lacking GAR. And now, when the essence of the HG returns, namely the vessels called Mantzpach, the lights come into their own vessels, and the Partzuf attains GAR. (962, Items 13, 14, and 15)
